description: This file contains a series of shell script tests designed to verify the behavior of the "safe.directory" feature in Git. It includes test setup, various test cases for different configurations of safe directories (including environment variables, git config, and glob patterns), and checks for correct handling of directory ownership and path normalization.

methods.name: expect_rejected_dir
methods.description: Checks that 'git status' fails with 'dubious ownership' error message.
